title: الخط الحمر عندو وقت
headline: خطوط حمرين؟ بداي قبل ما يوليو بيضين
problem: خرجو ليك خطوط حمرين جداد فالكرش من بعد الولادة.

hook_card.text:
ولدتي وخرجو ليك خطوط حمرين فالكرش؟
هادا هو الوقت

shots.vo_line: ولدتي وخرجو ليك خطوط حمرين فالكرش؟ الخط الحمر ماشي غير لون، هو جرح جديد… وعندو وقت.
shots.h3_prompt: The sand trickles steadily from the upper bulb into the lower one while the ring of light circles slowly around the hourglass (0-2.5 s). The red line on the skin below pulses softly and the belly rises and falls with slow breathing (2.5-5 s). The sand keeps flowing, the ring keeps circling and the breathing goes on until the end. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects, no people. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same tissue, colours and lighting for the whole clip; no faces, no people, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.

shots.vo_line: تحت الجلد، الجرح باقي طري، والعروق حداه عامرين بالدم. داكشي علاش حمر.
shots.h3_prompt: Blood pulses slowly through the swollen red vessels (0-2 s). The frayed edges of the tear quiver and the fibres beside it twitch slightly (2-4 s). The vessels keep pulsing in a slow, steady rhythm and the tissue breathes faintly until the end. The camera drifts very slowly and steadily sideways along the tear. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects, no people. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same tissue, colours and lighting for the whole clip; no faces, no people, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.

shots.vo_line: هادشي اللي كتكتب الماماوات: الخط الحمر كيقرص… ومن بعد كيبياض.

الجلد فيه طبقات. الطبقة اللولة بحال حيط مسدود، والزيوت كيوقفو عليه. الخط كاين فالطبقة اللي تحت، فين الكولاجين تقطع. غوتيفا خفيف، كيدوز بين الطوبات حتى للجرح، وكيعطي للجلد اللي خاصو باش يصلح راسو من الجذر.
إلا تخلّى، العروق كيخواو، والبلاصة كتولّي رقيقة وبلا لون. الحمر كيولّي بيض.
shots.h3_prompt: The last faint red slowly drains from the thin vessels (0-2 s). The fibres around the faint tear slacken and settle a little flatter (2-4.5 s). The tissue keeps a slow, faint breathing movement until the end, and the background keeps its pink colour. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects, no people. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same tissue, colours and lighting for the whole clip; no faces, no people, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.

shots.vo_line: ولكن ملي باقي حمر، الجلد باقي كيتجاوب.
shots.h3_prompt: A strong, slow wave of blood pulses back through the red vessels (0-1.5 s). The fibres along the tear stir and lean slightly toward each other (1.5-3 s). The vessels keep pulsing softly and the tissue keeps breathing until the end. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects, no people. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same tissue, colours and lighting for the whole clip; no faces, no people, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.

shots.vo_line: غوتيفا سيروم خفيف، كيوصل للجرح: الألوفيرا كتبرد الحمورية، وأركان وفيتامين E كيغذيو الجلد ويعاونوه يتجدد.
shots.h3_prompt: The clear drop slowly sinks into the tear and vanishes with a faint shimmer (0-3 s). The golden beads and green aloe pieces drift along the tear and melt into the fibres (3-6 s). The red vessels pulse slower and calmer while a soft golden glow keeps spreading along the tear until the end. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects, no people. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same tissue, colours and lighting for the whole clip; no faces, no people, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.

shots.vo_line: فـ 20 يوم الحمرين كيبداو يمشيو… و 60 يوم كيتمحاو كاملين.
shots.h3_prompt: The sand trickles steadily from the upper bulb into the lower one (0-2 s). The faint line on the skin below slowly fades into the surrounding skin until it is barely visible (2-4 s). The ring of light keeps circling slowly, the sand keeps flowing and the belly breathes gently until the end. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects, no people. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same tissue, colours and lighting for the whole clip; no faces, no people, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.

shots.vo_line: كل سيمانة كتسناي، الخط الحمر كيقرب يولّي بيض. بداي دابا.
shots.h3_prompt: The pink hourglass glows brighter and softer in a slow heartbeat rhythm (0-1.5 s). The sand trickles down in a thin stream while the ring of light circles slowly (1.5-3.5 s). The red line below keeps pulsing gently with the same heartbeat and the belly breathes slowly until the end. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects, no people. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same tissue, colours and lighting for the whole clip; no faces, no people, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.

shots.vo_line: جوج قراعي، شهرين كاملين، ب 299 درهم بلاصة 398. التوصيل فابور، وكتخلصي غير ملي يوصلك.

marks.text: كتخلصي ملي يوصلك · حلي الكولي قدام الليفرور
